model.parameters: 39.8B MoE (256 experts, top-6 sigmoid routing + shared expert)
model.attention: 49 layers: 35 sliding-window (window 513, RoPE), 14 full (no RoPE); GQA 32/4; attention sinks
model.weights: NVFP4 GGUF, served weight-only W4A16; LM head dequantized to BF16

engine.name: vLLM
engine.version: nightly (0.33.0rc1 or newer; Flint support is nightly-only)
engine.note: Nightly digest pinned 2026-10-26; Flint support and gguf>=0.19.0 are nightly-only.

serving.compilation: no torch.compile, CUDA graphs on (per recipe)

sampling_defaults.note: From generation_config.json; greedy decoding is not validated for this model.

host.note: Before start: room for ~23.5 GB of resident weights and the KV pool.

scope.note: Single Spark screening only. Recipe was verified on GB200, not GB10; kernel compatibility is itself a finding.
